#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

ll mul(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll e) {
    ll res = 1LL;
    while (e > 0LL) {
        if (e & 1LL) {
            res = mul(res, a);
        }
        a = mul(a, a);
        e >>= 1LL;
    }
    return res;
}

ll inv(ll a) {
    return pow_mod(a, MOD - 2LL);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    ll cnt = r - l + 1LL;
    ll cells = n * m;
    ll ans;

    if ((n & 1LL) && (m & 1LL)) {
        ans = pow_mod(cnt, cells);
    } else {
        ll p = pow_mod(cnt, cells - 1LL);
        if ((cnt & 1LL) == 0LL) {
            ans = mul(p, cnt / 2LL);
        } else {
            ll term1 = mul(p, (cnt + 1LL) / 2LL);
            ll term2 = mul((p + MOD - 1LL) % MOD, inv(2LL));
            ans = (term1 - term2) % MOD;
            if (ans < 0LL) {
                ans += MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
